content.title: Designing an Adaptive, Speaker-Context-Aware Cross-Paradigm NLP Artifact for IT Narrative Disclosure Measurement
content.abstract: Business communication in modern corporations is increasingly shaped by voluntary discourse channels such as earnings conference calls and merger and acquisition an- nouncement calls. A prominent element of these calls is the Information Technology (IT) narrative disclosure, where executives embed IT-related vocabulary as references to digital initiatives. However, measurement risk may arise when firms’ IT narratives diverge from actions, evading what single-paradigm dictionaries detect, a gap exacer- bated by post-Generative-AI (post-GenAI) vocabulary expansion.
